name: Old Woman
source:
The old woman who owns the love hotel the protagonist lives in, working him like a dog.

She's a well-informed member of the Kabukicho underworld who has ties to the Aoike Gathering and knows about both the protagonist's hit man side hustle and Yun's gang member past. 

[From Shiravune, via [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1433]MangaGamer[/url]]
